documents.text: supplement , Volume 1 — Dods , Marcus 1912 William Forbes Gray ​ DODS , MARCUS ( 1834–1909 ) , presbyterian divine and biblical scholar , born in Belford Vicarage , Northumberland , on 11 April 1834 , was youngest son of Marcus ​ Dods [ q. v. ] by his wife Sarah Palliser . On the father 's death in 1838 the family removed to Edinburgh , where Dods first attended a preparatory school and , later , Edinburgh Academy ( 1843-1848 ) .
